title: LIC's ₹21,000 crore IPO: how it was priced, and why it listed below the issue price
short: LIC's IPO: how it was priced, and why it listed lower
dek: In May 2022, India's biggest insurer went public in what was then the country's largest IPO. Policyholders rushed in. The shares opened 8% lower.
card: India's biggest IPO at the time was nearly 3 times subscribed. It still opened 8% below the issue price.
sources: Finology Ticker: LIC IPO details and subscription
Business Standard: LIC lists at 8.6% discount
Onmanorama: LIC lists at 8.11% discount at ₹872 on NSE
